subject: Proposed Serving Architecture Workshop — NimbusHealth / Redwood
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Intro + Next Steps: Serving Architecture Workshop

Alicia — great to meet during discovery this morning. Thanks for the background on your inference throughput and privacy constraints. As discussed, the next best step is a 60–90 minute technical workshop so our solutions engineering team can walk through an architecture that meets your latency and data-residency requirements and map a mutual action plan.

Proposed brief agenda (60–90 min):
- 15 min: goals, current infra, constraints (your side)
- 25 min: proposed serving architecture + tradeoffs (Redwood)
- 15 min: integration checklist (network, auth, data flows)
- 10–20 min: open Q&A + next steps / action items

Possible time slots (PST):
- Fri Nov 19: 10:00–11:00
- Sat Nov 20: 13:00–14:00

Can you confirm preferred slot and whether you want us to demonstrate Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private (we can focus on one)? Also, if your infra team needs a VPN jump server or temporary peering for deeper network testing, let us know so we can provision in advance.

If it helps, I can include Soojin (SE) and Marissa (Solutions Manager) on the call.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
https://cal.redwood.ai/jonas
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-18T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + Next Steps: Serving Architecture Workshop

Hi Alicia — thanks Jonas and nice to e-meet. Quick follow-up from my side with more detail on what we typically cover in the technical deep dive so you can decide who from your team to bring. I attached a short agenda PDF and a tiny sample payload file so we can calibrate token sizes ahead of time.

Expanded topics we can dig into:
- Inference topology: hosted vs dedicated GPU pools vs private (VPC/on‑prem)
- Model variants & quantization options for perf/cost tradeoffs
- KV cache and prefix caching strategies for conversational workloads
- Network and egress considerations: peering, NAT, and estimated bandwidth
- Auth & data protection: SSO (SAML/OIDC), KMS workflows, audit logs
- Rollout plan: canary testing, fallback policies, and metrics to watch

If you have sample prompt/response sizes and expected rps for peak windows, please drop them in reply — that helps me create an initial sizing slide.

I can run the session with a live demo of an example model and we can bring in Marissa for contract/ops questions near the end. For timing, I can do the Nov 20 slot (13:00–14:00 PST) but if you need later that day I can also do 14:30–15:30 PST.

Attachments: serving_workshop_agenda_v1.pdf (pdf), prework_sample_payloads.json (json stub)

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0134
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@nimbushealth.com>

Cc: Tom Sutherland <tom.s@nh-corp.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + Next Steps: Serving Architecture Workshop

Thanks Jonas & Soojin. Nov 20 works better for our team. We were hoping to push the start a bit to 14:30 PST (our infra lead is in back-to-back meetings until 14:00). Is 14:30–15:30 PST possible?

A few items to confirm before the call:
- SSO/SAML support: Our security team needs to know if Redwood can integrate with our Okta setup and support SCIM provisioning.
- Data residency: some of our PHI processing must stay in US regions. Do you have region-specific deployment options and an EU data residency guarantee (we may expand there later)?
- SOC 2 evidence: I attached our short questionnaire, and we’ll need your SOC 2 cert and a short summary of retention/audit log capabilities.

I added Tom Sutherland (infra) to the thread — he’ll join the workshop.

Attachment: NHC-Security-Questionnaire.pdf

— Alicia
Alicia Gomez | Director, Product Operations
NimbusHealth

Alicia / Tom — 14:30–15:30 PST on Nov 20 is good on our side; I’ve created a calendar event and provisional Teams link below. I’ll run through the architecture walkthrough and a short demo of Dedicated vs Private deployment footprints.

Practical notes before the workshop:
- SSO/SCIM: Redwood supports SAML 2.0 and OIDC; we can walk through an Okta example and a short SCIM provisioning flow during the demo. I’ll bring the engineer who owns our SSO integrations.
- Data residency: we can pin model serving to a US region for the PoC; we also have EU regions we can discuss for a staged rollout.
- SOC 2: I’ve attached our SOC 2 summary and retention docs to the calendar item and linked an internal runbook. If you need the full attestation, I can route that through our security team prior to the call.

Calendar: https://cal.redwood.ai/meet/soojin/serving-workshop-nh
Recording: session will be recorded on request
Attachments: serving_workshop_agenda_v1.pdf, prework_sample_payloads.json

Thanks — looking forward to the workshop. I’ll prepare a short slide on cost/perf tradeoffs for different quantization and pooling strategies.
